aboutText: Based in Ivanhoe, Remedy Floor has been transforming spaces with premium epoxy flooring solutions for years. Our expertise spans commercial, industrial, and residential projects, ensuring each floor is not only visually stunning but also built to last. We pride ourselves on attention to detail, timely service, and exceeding client expectations in every job we undertake.
servicesText: From high-traffic commercial areas to cosy home garages, Remedy Floor offers comprehensive epoxy flooring services. We handle everything from surface preparation to the final coat, using top-grade materials to ensure longevity and beauty. Serving Ivanhoe and nearby suburbs, we guarantee professional results for every project.
